scope.goal: Drive a local tall-encounter-grass response and footfall rustle only while grounded moving units cross the authored visible grass footprint.

implementation.route_selection: Every named unfinished route retains its own theme/state identity but temporarily resolves its backdrop, height field, and encounter-grass queries to the complete authored Route 1 scene.
implementation.contact_detection: Grounded moving board units are transformed from gameplay world space into LGPE source centimetres and tested against visible, unsuppressed encounter-grass modules with elevation rejection.
implementation.blade_response: Nearby modules add a bounded directional contact rotation to the existing source-pivot joint palette, with quick attack and slower release; distant modules retain ambient motion only.
implementation.particle_first_pass: A small leaf burst follows movement cadence only inside the same authored footprint and uses the engine's existing leaf particle presentation.

evidence_boundary: The VFXB container, resident registration, emitter names, embedded BNTX identity, texture names, and encounter-grass skinning inputs are direct game-file evidence.

The exact VFXB emitter curve/field schema has not yet been decoded, so first-pass emission rate, lifetime, velocity, and contact-joint response are source-constrained reconstruction values rather than claimed original constants.
Exact parity requires a cooker for the three VFXB emitters and six embedded BNTX textures; the original ROMFS files remain local and are not committed.
